snippet.title: Definitely Not Fried Chicken | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
NOW WE'RE REALLY COOKING!

Definitely Not Fried Chicken has now hatched out of Early Access with a bunch of deliciously-dope new content!

Expand your drug farm and appeal to new customers with a brand new drug line - COCAINE!

Perhaps you want to open up a new business? Why not try our legitimate CASINO and NIGHTCLUB businesses!

Sell to new special and suspicious customers - NUNS and THE DEVIL HIMSELF!

+ new delivery vehicle, story-line conclusion and more!

But just because we're hitting v1.0, do you really think we're stopping there? No - DNFC is looking to the future!

Build your drug empire today and run a perfectly legitimate chain of businesses today in Definitely Not Fried Chicken - now with 20% launch discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036240/Definitely_Not_Fried_Chicken/
